plan: Given the private value of $29, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly above the expected value of competitors' bids to maximize profit. Since other bidders are rational and values range from $0 to $20, they may bid close to their value. A bid of $19.1 maximizes the chance of winning while ensuring profit since the prize value is much higher than the maximum possible second-highest bid.

Given my private value of $27, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a high chance of winning. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, a rational strategy is to bid just below the value, considering other bidders will bid close to their values too. I will bid $26.9 to outbid others valuing the prize around $26 or less, maximizing my potential profit if I win.

Given my value of $25, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive expected profit. Bidding exactly $25 risks zero profit if I win, and bidding above $25 guarantees a loss. Rational bidders will bid slightly below their values, so I should aim to bid around $24 to maximize my chance of winning while ensuring profit.
